title: 第三章
slug: 娇软妹宝随军后禁欲军官沦陷了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

当即冷了脸说，“你这人怎么回事？明明我都不认识你，却一直跟我套近乎，现在又对售货员说出这样似是而非的话，是想误导他们，我们是一块的，好待会找个由头把我拐下去对吗？”

苏清荔前世时，就在电视上见过这种骗局。

没想到今天就遇上了。

那一男一女没想到苏清荔看起来挺不谙世事的，心思却如此深沉。

将他俩的心思猜的一清二楚。

眼看售货员表情有些不对，那女人慌忙解释，“不是的，我就是看小姑娘人挺面善的，这才多照顾了几分。”

说罢，她苦笑一声。

“我也没想到自己善意的举动，却让她联想那么多，是我的错，我给你道歉。”

围观的群众见她表情很是真诚，再比对咄咄逼人的苏清荔，纷纷开始指责她。

“别人一片好心，她却当成驴肝肺，真是不知好歹！”

“是啊，”有人见苏清荔长得妖妖娆娆的，早就不顺眼了，“还真以为自己是天仙啊？是个人对她都心怀不轨？我看就是自恋过头了。”

眼看众人纷纷为她说话，那女人脸上多了几分得意。

见此，苏清荔冷笑一声。

“我从头到尾都没理你，要说面善，旁边这个大姐不比我强？你怎么不照顾她？”

话落，本就眼馋苏清荔手上肉包子的邻座大姐一拍大腿，“是啊，我刚才还帮你拿行李呢，你咋不给我？”

“我......”

眼看那女人支支吾吾的说不出来，众人都觉得不对劲了。

一旁乘务员员，更是直接叫了乘警，“6号厢房有些状况，过来一下。”

与此同时。

傅谨严和副官也在这辆火车上。

听到6号厢房传来的动静，副官有些好奇，“傅团，咱们要不要过去看看？”

见傅谨严没兴趣。

副官就起身，打算去凑凑热闹。

恰在此时，乘警接到乘务员的通知后，也朝这边赶。

“都让让。”

听到乘警的声音，男人的目光一瞬间变得凶狠。

苏清荔从刚才戳破两人时，就暗自将一颗心提起。

见男人不动声色朝自己靠近，手还背在身后，立刻后退两步，“快躲开，他手里有刀！”

随着苏清荔话落，周围人群就跟遇到冷水的热油似的，纷纷朝旁边后退。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

He immediately said with a cold face, "What's the matter with you? I don't even know you, but you keep getting close to me. Now you say such specious words to the salesperson. You want to mislead them. We are on the same side. You can find an excuse to abduct me later, right?"

Su Qingli had seen this kind of scam on TV in her previous life.

I didn't expect to meet it today.

The man and woman did not expect that Su Qingli seemed to be quite ignorant of the world, but she was so thoughtful.

He could guess their thoughts clearly.

Seeing that the salesperson had something wrong with her expression, the woman hurriedly explained, "No, I just saw that the little girl was very kind, so I took more care of her."

After saying that, she smiled bitterly.

"I didn't expect that my kind actions would make her think so much. It's my fault. I apologize to you."

The onlookers saw that her expression was very sincere, and compared with the aggressive Su Qingli, they all began to accuse her.

"Others have good intentions, but she treats them like a donkey. She is so ungrateful!"

"Yeah," someone saw Su Qingli's voluptuous appearance and was already displeased with her. "Do you really think that you are a fairy? Is it someone who has evil intentions towards her? I think she is too narcissistic."

Seeing everyone speaking for her, the woman's face became a little prouder.

Seeing this, Su Qingli sneered.

"I ignored you from the beginning to the end. If you want to be kind, the elder sister next to you is not better than me? Why don't you take care of her?"

After saying that, the sister sitting next to her, who was already coveting the meat buns on Su Qingli's hand, slapped her thigh and said, "Yes, I was helping you carry your luggage just now, why don't you give it to me?"

"I..."

Seeing that the woman was hesitating and unable to speak, everyone felt that something was wrong.

The flight attendant on the side even called the flight police directly, "There is something going on in compartment 6, come here."

At the same time.

Fu Jingyan and his adjutant were also on the train.

Hearing the noise coming from Wing 6, the adjutant was a little curious, "Fu Tuan, should we go over and have a look?"

He was not interested in seeing Fu Jinyan.

The adjutant got up and planned to join in the fun.

At this moment, after receiving the notification from the flight attendant, the flight police also rushed here.

"Give it all."

Hearing the police officer's voice, the man's eyes instantly became fierce.

Su Qingli secretly raised her heart when she exposed the two of them just now.

Seeing the man approaching her calmly with his hands behind his back, he immediately took two steps back and said, "Get out of the way, he has a knife in his hand!"

As Su Qingli finished speaking, the crowd around him retreated like hot oil in cold water.
